These are two names for the same essential reality. However, this is a single pair — two nodes, one bechina edge — which falls well below the threshold of 3+ concepts forming an independent domain.

The Torah does not develop a network of bechina relationships among multiple concepts. Its entire conceptual move is a single causal (eitza) argument: knowing the typology of Torahs → recognizing a Jew → because Israel's essence is Oral Torah. There is no branching cluster of concepts equated through bechina language that would constitute an independent package.

Recommendation: Enter the bechina pair {'מה שלא נתן לכתב' ↔ 'תורה שבעל פה'} into the dataset (reference 1028, type 'bechina') and revisit package formation if additional bechina edges are discovered for this Torah in other sources.
